label: DTI-Derived Evaluation of Glymphatic System Function in Veterans with Chronic Multisymptom Illness.
summary: Chronic multisymptom illness (CMI) includes symptoms of fatigue, pain, and sleep difficulties, as well as neurologic, respiratory, and gastrointestinal problems and is particularly common in veterans from the 1990-1991 Gulf War and the Afghanistan and Iraq Wars. Glymphatic system function may play an important role in the etiopathology of CMI but has not been addressed.
